description: Metro de Panamá, S.A. – Demanda de Usuarios en Líneas 1 y 2, años 2018 a 2026 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Metro de Panamá. Demanda de Usuarios Línea 1 y Línea 2 del Metro de Panamá, desglosada por días laborables, sábados y feriados. Datos distribuidos por mes, correspondiente a los años 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 y 2026. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Metro de Panamá. Its tags are dias feriados, dias laborables, movimiento de pasajeros. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
